scope: Only seven named sources inspected. Unscored preparation; no trials, live access, archive inspection, additional agents or source mutations.

case_checks.finding: Every case has a valued outcome, four hard constraints, bounded hypothetical resources, two normal observations, one explicit awkward observation, an adverse disturbance, two source-known parent functions with operating paths, and bounded probe resources. These permit comparative proposed operations, anomaly rivals, carrier changes and interface tests; no mechanism is stipulated successful.
case_checks.epistemic_status: All six are supplied_synthetic_task. Descriptions of equipment, records and sealed keys do not supply live equipment, datasets or operational oracles.

fresh_packet_checks.coverage: Each packet has exactly three candidates; all 24 have claim, causal_relation, full discriminator, proposed probe, uncertainty and fit. Discriminators retain adverse outcomes, rival limitations, absent performance orderings and conditions; no measured superiority is asserted.
fresh_packet_checks.fit_semantics: All four conditional candidates explicitly require hard-constraint relaxation. All five uncertain candidates identify indispensable unknown resources without requesting relaxation. Every violating candidate is explicitly rejected/parked; FA-C2/respondent-clarify is explicitly parked conditional. Rejection retains uncertainties and does not establish a competing mechanism.
fresh_packet_checks.protected_content: All candidates, including parked/rejected IDs and complete discriminator/probe caveats, remain in the compression assessment pool.

calibration_checks.exact_ids: CAL01-CAL12, one matching key each; every expected answer is allowed; source references agree and resolve in named rubric/contracts.
calibration_checks.entailment: Registry overrides misleading filenames; a forward chain lacks feedback/removal; unreviewed concurrent families gate exclusivity; renamed resistance and additive unchanged-link benefit fail conversion/interaction. Unknown borrowed resources imply uncertain fit; hidden maintenance fails relocation. Identical rival predictions score observability 1. Opposed decision-changing predictions meet P08. Missing raw lineage/review prevents completion. P10 permits locked partial contracts but excludes uncertain family links. Logical contraposition alone cannot settle carrier/path family identity.
calibration_checks.ambiguity_policy: CAL12 remains uncertain. Anchors do not resolve real candidate-family disputes or replace two independent scored reviews.

phase_checks.finding: Cases and fresh packets separate pilot from confirmation with distinct IDs and balanced transfer domains. Portfolio I01 is a readiness diagnostic, not a calibration-effect comparison. I09 separates H028/former K2 historical diagnostics from four fresh pilot packets and four fresh confirmation packets. I10/I13 reuse exact I06 pools; this is explicitly not independent replication. Optional human phases require access, consent and an independent frozen oracle.
phase_checks.verification_limit: Historical packet contents and prospective exact assessment-context bindings were outside this role; their provenance/coverage is not certified here.

capacity.measurement: Whitespace-split serialized JSON/source words are input proxies. Summary/output counts are prospective saved-word estimates. Tokens, internal calls and model context capacity are unknown.
capacity.compressor_formula: 3 complete packets x 3 compressor arms x 350 saved words
capacity.required_output: 27 case/raw-ID/compressor rows; 81 relation/discriminator/uncertainty retention judgments, plus per-row fit, lineage consistency and explicit disposition; nine summary-level unsupported-addition/coverage checks. Full discriminator components need source-linked rationale, not one unexplained conjunction.
capacity.output_formula: 27 rows x 65 words + 9 packet-arm checks x 30 words + 200 words metadata/findings
capacity.conclusion: Compact complete coverage plausibly fits 2500 saved words, with little margin; this is an estimate, not an executed reviewer capacity result. Largest historical-containing shard remains unmeasured because diagnostic source packets are excluded from this role. No review or shard redesign performed.

flags.finding: Preserves is a source-stipulated proposal label, not proof of live availability or operational feasibility. Retain it faithfully during compression; assess deployment/probe resource uncertainty separately.

Inherited rubric retains 22000 review words, a 2500 input proxy and four historical main blocks. Current portfolio specifies 2500 saved reviewer words and current phase units; this preflight uses that current allowance. Input words above 2500 are not output overflow or known token overflow.

Two full ten-cycle configuration tests may exceed twelve total closure/pull trials if every closure counts as a trial. Trial-count interpretation needs clarification before physical execution; proposed model comparison remains identifiable.
Capacity estimate covers fresh fixtures only; historical diagnostic packet sizes cannot be bounded from these sources.

claim_ceiling: Preparation supports bounded model proposal/fidelity comparisons. It proves no physical efficacy, operational workflow success, human decision benefit, real access, statistical power or completed experiment.
